selection_policy: top yearly-profitable strategies by full-period profit factor, de-duplicated by edge composition

strategies.caveat: Annual profitability is evaluated only from activation_start_year onward; full_history_candidate=true is required for all available history.

strengths: Every active calendar year is net profitable.
Meets the annual trade frequency, win-probability, and positive-PnL target after activation.
Most recent test window is net profitable.
High trade count reduces dependence on a tiny number of events.
weaknesses: Return-to-drawdown is moderate; risk sizing needs restraint.
